title: Private Forest Bathing Experience Connect with Nature
includes: Nourishing Tea Ceremony using locally Foraged Ingredients
Gratuities (not mandatory but greatly appreciated) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Immerse yourself in the calming embrace of nature with a private guided Forest Bathing session. This experience offers a unique chance to slow down and connect with the forest through mindfulness practices and breath work. Enjoy a relaxed pace as you explore the serene surroundings, allowing the sights, sounds, and smells of the woods to enhance your personal journey of introspection and tranquility. Perfect for anyone looking to recharge their mental and physical well-being, this experience invites you to discover the profound benefits of spending time in nature.
